name: loop-harness
description: Trigger -> Maker -> Checker -> stop decision loop harness core

scripts.description: LP-1 loop_step CLI: start/attach/propose/complete/reconcile/heartbeat/resume with JSON output
LP-2 headless worker: drives Maker/Checker via `claude -p`, calls loop_common directly
LP-2 resident scheduler: label-queue discovery, concurrency cap, worker spawn/restart
LP-2 status CLI: list/show/purge over loop-run state
